# CREDITS — Literally Just a Stack of Pylons

Asset policy (approved by Jared, Game Director, 2026-10-09): the game ships only assets that are **CC0, in-house, or paid-licensed** (none paid at this time), and every shipped asset is listed here. SIL OFL fonts are allowed; music must be CC0.

**AI-generated content disclosure (policy approved).** Two sets of images in this project were pre-generated by Jared with AI tools and are disclosed for Steam's "Pre-Generated" AI-content category:
- the **planter bark** texture set (`materials/planter_bark_texture_set_2048/`) was made with **ChatGPT** (OpenAI);
- the **vehicle side-photo textures** (`Models/<kind>_0/_1.png`, also embedded in the vehicle glbs, `Models/police_car_0.png`, `Models/sedan/*` photo maps) were made with **Grok** (xAI).
Everything else (models, textures, audio and VFX) is hand-made, generated by our own scripts, or CC0-licensed. Details: §6.

Licence texts: `docs/licenses/` (CC0 1.0 legal code, SIL OFL 1.1 for Overpass, Freesound licence-page snapshots, ambientCG notes). CC0 assets need no attribution; authors are listed as a courtesy.

## 2. In-house assets (Jared), per Game Director
Jared states he made these. Where a tool-chain or generator is known from file metadata, it is noted. **Not independently verified.**

| Group | Files | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Standard traffic cone | `Models/standard_cone.glb`, `Models/standard_cone_base.stl`, `standard_cone_cone.stl`, `standard_cone_stripe.stl` | STLs exported from SketchUp (file headers); the glb was generated by `stl_cone_to_glb` |
| Road segment kit | `Models/road_segments/*.stl` (20 files) | SketchUp STL exports |
| Street furniture kit | `Models/road_decorations/*.stl` (14 files: lamps, signals, signs, sign post, medians, parking barrier) | SketchUp STL exports |
| Building kit | `Models/building_parts/strip_mall_with_columns_base_segment.stl` | SketchUp STL export |
| Baked road modules | `Models/road_modules/straight_tile.glb`, `intersection.glb`, `turn_right.glb`, `ports.json` | in-house bake (`pylons-road-bake`) from the STL kit |
| Vehicle **meshes** (geometry) | 29 fleet glbs: ambulance, bus, car, coach, compact, coupe, delivery, dump, fire, flatbed, foodtruck, garbage, limousine, mail, minivan, mixer, motorcycle, pickup, rv, schoolbus, scooter, suv, sweeper, taxi, tow, truck, utility, van, wagon (`Models/<kind>.glb`) | geometry lofted by an in-house pipeline (`pylons-fleet-loft`). **The embedded photo textures are a separate question: see §3** |
| Police car mesh | `Models/police_car.glb` | in-house pipeline (`pylons-police-photo`). Texture: see §3 |
| Sedan rig meshes | `Models/sedan/body.glb`, `door_front.glb`, `door_rear.glb`, `windshield.glb`, `wheel.glb`, `axle.glb`, `door.glb` | in-house pipeline (`pylons-sedan-photo` / `pylons-sedan-parts`, `Models/sedan/photo-parts.md`). Textures: see §3 |

## 6. AI-generated content disclosure (Steam) - added 2026-10-09
Policy: allowed only when disclosed here (this is §6; style-guide §13–§14); prefer CC0 or in-house replacements. "AI" = images or models produced by a generative-AI tool.

| Vehicle side-photo textures | `Models/<kind>_0/_1.png` (29 pairs, also embedded), `police_car_0.png`, `Models/sedan/*` photo maps | **Yes** | Jared (via the Assistant Director, 2026-10-09): pre-generated content he made with **Grok**; consistent with `Models/sedan/photo-parts.md` ("newly generated car photo", generation API) | **Grok** (xAI). Commercial-use terms not yet recorded: Jared to confirm | Disclose while shipped; longer term replace with modelled vehicles |
